newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokai Bank to take over failed credit union in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Tokai Bank to take over failed credit union in Jan.

text.p: The Osaka prefectural government said on Monday that Tokai Bank Ltd would take over the healthy assets of failed credit union Osaka Shinyo Kumiai on January 20.

On the same day, non-performing assets at Osaka Kumiai will be transferred to the Resolution and Collection Bank Ltd (RCB), a body responsible for managing and collecting bad loans of failed credit unions, the Osaka government said.

The RCB will also take over the management of Kizu Shinyo Kumiai, another failed credit union based in Osaka, on February 24, it said. Credit Unions are small financial institutions which take deposits and make loans, mainly to members.
